title: StarDojo: Benchmarking Open-Ended Behaviors of Agentic Multimodal LLMs in Production–Living Simulations with Stardew Valley
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark called StarDojo based on the game Stardew Valley. It focuses on evaluating AI agents' capabilities in production activities (farming, crafting) and social interactions within a game simulation. It does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical components.
